required.name: ROID_REPOSITORY_ID
required.description: The registry's EPP repository ID, registered with IANA (https://www.iana.org/assignments/epp-repository-ids): 1 to 8 letters or digits. Every ROID ends in it (e.g. 123_DOM-XYZ): only the number is stored, and the ID is appended when a ROID is read. Set it once, before the first start: the database records it then, and a process configured with a different one refuses to start. Any value will do for local development

required.name: STORAGE_ENDPOINT
required.description: S3-compatible endpoint, hostname only, no scheme. AWS S3: s3.<region>.amazonaws.com. Required even when STORAGE_AUTH_MODE=iam — the client is minio-go and does not resolve an endpoint from the region. Falls back to deprecated MINIO_ENDPOINT

optional.name: DATABASE_URL
optional.description: PostgreSQL connection URL. Embeds the password, so it is credential material. Alternative to the DB_* set — configure one of the two; on AWS prefer DB_* so the managed password never passes through a URL.

optional.name: DB_USER
optional.description: PostgreSQL user. The DB_* set is the production credential path on AWS ECS; used whenever DATABASE_URL is unset

optional.name: DB_PASS
optional.description: PostgreSQL password. The DB_* set is the production credential path on AWS ECS (inject from the secret store); used whenever DATABASE_URL is unset

optional.name: DB_HOST
optional.description: PostgreSQL host; used whenever DATABASE_URL is unset

optional.name: DB_PORT
optional.description: PostgreSQL port; used whenever DATABASE_URL is unset

optional.name: DB_NAME
optional.description: PostgreSQL database name; used whenever DATABASE_URL is unset

optional.name: DB_SSLMODE
optional.description: PostgreSQL SSL mode

optional.name: DB_MAX_OPEN_CONNS
optional.description: Database connections one process may open, at least 2 (a migration holds one for its lock while the schema changes run on another); a quarter of them are kept idle, each is recycled after 30 minutes and closed after 5 idle minutes. The worker needs at least 3: it gives a quarter of it (at least 1, at most 5) to the one pool its escrow importers share and the rest to the pool every other activity shares, never more than the budget in all. Size it so every process together stays under the database's connection limit. The EPP and RDAP nodes use EPP_DB_MAX_OPEN_CONNS and RDAP_DB_MAX_OPEN_CONNS instead

optional.name: AUTO_MIGRATE
optional.description: Migrate the schema on startup (local development). Deployed environments leave this false and run the `migrate` job before rolling services - see docs/adr/0010-database-migrations.md

optional.name: SCHEMA_GUARD
optional.description: Startup check that schema_version is at least this build's version: enforce (refuse to start), warn (log and continue) or off. Emergency escape hatch only - leave unset (enforce) in deployed environments

optional.name: AUTH0_ENABLED
optional.description: Enable Auth0 JWT validation

optional.name: AUTH0_DOMAIN
optional.description: Auth0 tenant domain (e.g. dev-xxx.us.auth0.com)

optional.name: AUTH0_AUDIENCE
optional.description: Auth0 API identifier (e.g. https://api.alpaca-test)

optional.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
optional.description: Legacy bearer token (fallback when Auth0 disabled)

optional.name: SNOWFLAKE_NODE_ID
optional.description: The snowflake node this process mints ROIDs on, 0 to 1023; every ROID carries it. One range for every process that writes the same database: two processes on one node can mint the same ROID in the same millisecond, and the second create then fails. Give each service a block and each replica its offset in it: api 0-99, worker 100-199, epp 200-299, cli and importers 900-999, so api-0 is 0, worker-0 is 100, epp-2 is 202. Unset, the node is derived from the host, which is fine for one process and a gamble for a fleet

optional.description: API bind host / target host for worker calls

optional.name: API_PORT
optional.description: API bind port / target port for worker calls

optional.name: API_VERSION
optional.description: API version for Swagger docs

optional.description: Gin framework mode (debug/release)

optional.name: CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
optional.description: Comma-separated allowed origins for CORS

optional.name: TEMPORAL_UI_URL

optional.name: STORAGE_AUTH_MODE
optional.description: How to obtain S3 credentials: "static" (access key + secret; MinIO, R2, S3) or "iam" (short-lived credentials from EKS IRSA, ECS task role, or EC2 IMDS; AWS S3 only)

optional.name: STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY
optional.description: S3 access key ID. Required when STORAGE_AUTH_MODE=static; must be unset for iam. Falls back to deprecated MINIO_ACCESS_KEY

optional.name: STORAGE_SECRET_KEY
optional.description: S3 secret access key. Required when STORAGE_AUTH_MODE=static; must be unset for iam. Falls back to deprecated MINIO_SECRET_KEY

optional.name: STORAGE_USE_SSL
optional.description: Use TLS for S3 connections. Falls back to deprecated MINIO_USE_SSL

optional.name: STORAGE_REGION
optional.description: S3 region for SigV4 signing. Set to the bucket's region for AWS S3, "auto" for R2. Empty lets the client resolve it via a bucket-location lookup

optional.name: STORAGE_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT
optional.description: Public S3 endpoint for presigned URLs (if different from STORAGE_ENDPOINT). Falls back to deprecated MINIO_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT

optional.name: STORAGE_ESCROW_BUCKET
optional.description: S3 bucket name for RDE/BRDA escrow deposits (contains PII — kept isolated per bucket-storage-strategy)

optional.name: STORAGE_EVENT_LOGS_BUCKET
optional.description: S3 bucket name for gzip JSONL event archive files (warm-tier event search + audit trail)

optional.name: STORAGE_REPORTS_BUCKET
optional.description: S3 bucket name for Spec 5 compliance sweep CSVs and other generated reports. API needs it too for the generic workflow artifact download endpoint

optional.name: STORAGE_TEMP_BUCKET
optional.description: S3 bucket name for workflow-scoped staging artifacts (snapshots, backups, cleanup manifests, verification reports). API needs it too for the generic workflow artifact download endpoint

optional.name: STORAGE_TLS_SKIP_VERIFY
optional.description: Disable TLS certificate verification for S3 connections. Local development against self-signed MinIO only — never enable against R2/S3

optional.name: STORAGE_AUTO_CREATE_BUCKETS
optional.description: Create missing storage buckets on startup. Local development only — production buckets are provisioned out-of-band

optional.name: ESCROW_UPLOAD_DIR
optional.description: Local temp dir for escrow file uploads before S3 transfer

optional.name: NEW_RELIC_ENABLED
optional.description: Enable New Relic APM

optional.name: NEW_RELIC_LICENSE_KEY
optional.description: New Relic license key

optional.name: PROMETHEUS_ENABLED
optional.description: Enable Prometheus metrics endpoint

optional.name: LOG_DOMAIN_EVENTS
optional.description: Log domain lifecycle events

optional.name: REDIS_HOST
optional.description: Redis holding the EPP session registry, lockouts and command rates, and the RDAP request rates. The admin API reads it to list and end EPP sessions

optional.name: REDIS_PORT
optional.description: Redis port

optional.name: REDIS_PASSWORD
optional.description: Redis password (empty = no auth)

optional.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
optional.description: Anthropic API key for AI agent (Agent Alpaca)

optional.name: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
optional.description: Anthropic API base URL override

optional.name: LLM_MODEL
optional.description: LLM model name for the AI agent (e.g. claude-sonnet-5)

optional.name: KNOWLEDGE_BASE_DIR
optional.description: Root directory for knowledge base docs (docs/index.yaml). Falls back to working directory.

optional.name: ESCROW_CUSTODY_BACKEND
optional.description: Escrow key store: none or aws-secrets-manager. With none, public keys and unsigned deposits still work, and importing or probing a private key reports KEY_STORE_NOT_CONFIGURED

optional.name: ESCROW_CUSTODY_AWS_REGION
optional.description: AWS region of the Secrets Manager holding escrow key material

optional.name: ESCROW_CUSTODY_NAME_PREFIX
optional.description: Prefix of every escrow key secret name (<prefix>/escrow-keys/...). IAM policies are written against it; a stored reference keeps its full name, so changing the prefix does not orphan existing keys

optional.name: ESCROW_CUSTODY_KMS_ID
optional.description: Optional customer-managed KMS key (id, ARN or alias) that encrypts new escrow key secrets; empty uses the account's aws/secretsmanager key

optional.name: ESCROW_CUSTODY_ENDPOINT
optional.description: Secrets Manager endpoint override for development (LocalStack, e.g. http://localstack:4566). Leave empty in AWS

optional.name: ESCROW_CUSTODY_RECOVERY_WINDOW_DAYS
optional.description: Days a destroyed escrow key secret can still be recovered (7-30) before Secrets Manager deletes it

optional.name: LOG_LEVEL
optional.description: Log level (debug/info/warn/error)

optional.name: EPP_PORT
optional.description: EPP server TCP listen port

optional.name: EPP_OPS_PORT
optional.description: Plain-HTTP port serving /healthz, /readyz and /metrics. Never expose it publicly

optional.name: EPP_TLS_CERT_PATH
optional.description: Path to the PEM server certificate (with chain) presented to registrars. Hot-reloaded when the file changes. The certificate itself is public; mount it with its key

optional.name: EPP_TLS_KEY_PATH
optional.description: Path to the PEM private key for EPP_TLS_CERT_PATH. The path is not secret; the key file it names is, so mount it from the secret store

optional.name: EPP_TLS_SELF_SIGNED
optional.description: Present a generated self-signed certificate instead of EPP_TLS_CERT_PATH. Local development only

optional.name: EPP_SERVER_NAME
optional.description: Hostname registrars connect to (RST's epp.hostName). When set, a server certificate that does not cover it is refused at start and on reload. Set it in every deployment

optional.name: EPP_TLS_RELOAD_INTERVAL
optional.description: How often the certificate files are checked for a renewal

optional.name: EPP_PROXY_PROTOCOL
optional.description: Require a PROXY protocol header on every connection. Must be true behind a load balancer, or per-IP limits see only the balancer

optional.name: EPP_PROXY_TRUSTED_CIDRS
optional.description: Comma-separated CIDRs or IPs of the load balancers allowed to send PROXY headers. Connections from anywhere else are dropped

optional.name: EPP_REQUIRE_ALLOWLIST
optional.description: Drop connections from outside every registrar's allowed networks before TLS, and refuse a login from outside its own registrar's. Set false only for local development

optional.name: EPP_CREDENTIAL_REFRESH_INTERVAL
optional.description: How often a node reloads the allowed networks and ends sessions whose credentials were retired as compromised

optional.name: EPP_MAX_CONCURRENT_LOGINS
optional.description: Password verifications in progress on one node; each Argon2id verification holds 19 MiB. More wait their turn

optional.name: EPP_MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS
optional.description: Failed logins one session may make before it is answered 2501 and closed

optional.name: EPP_NODE_ID
optional.description: Name of this node in the session registry, shown when listing sessions. Defaults to the hostname

optional.name: EPP_SESSION_LEASE
optional.description: How long a session stays in the shared registry without a renewal; a crashed node's sessions disappear after this

optional.name: EPP_SESSION_HEARTBEAT
optional.description: How often a node renews its sessions in the registry. At most half of EPP_SESSION_LEASE

optional.name: EPP_MAX_SESSIONS_PER_SOURCE_IP
optional.description: Live sessions from one source address, across every node. Over it, the connection is closed before the greeting

optional.name: EPP_MAX_CREATES_IN_FLIGHT
optional.description: <domain:create>s one EPP node runs at once; waiting creates are let in one registrar or family at a time, in turn. Below EPP_DB_MAX_OPEN_CONNS

optional.name: EPP_CREATE_QUEUE_WAIT
optional.description: Longest a <domain:create> waits for a slot before it is refused with 2400

optional.name: EPP_AUDIT_RETENTION
optional.description: How long the EPP audit log keeps each command and response; older rows are deleted hourly

optional.name: EPP_AUDIT_QUERY_RESPONSES
optional.description: Also keep the response frames of queries (check, info, poll req) in the audit log. Transforms always keep both frames

optional.name: EPP_AUDIT_BUFFER
optional.description: Query records one node may hold before writing them in a batch. When full, records are written one by one; none is dropped

optional.name: EPP_DB_MAX_OPEN_CONNS
optional.description: Database connections one EPP node may open

optional.name: EPP_MAX_CONNECTIONS
optional.description: Open connections allowed on one node

optional.name: EPP_MAX_HANDSHAKES
optional.description: TLS handshakes allowed in progress on one node

optional.name: EPP_MAX_FRAME_BYTES
optional.description: Largest EPP frame accepted, including its 4-byte header. A larger frame closes the session

optional.name: EPP_XML_MAX_DEPTH
optional.description: Deepest element nesting accepted in a frame

optional.name: EPP_XML_MAX_ELEMENTS
optional.description: Most elements accepted in a frame

optional.name: EPP_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT
optional.description: Time from TCP accept (including any PROXY header) to a completed TLS handshake

optional.name: EPP_LOGIN_TIMEOUT
optional.description: Time from greeting to a successful <login>

optional.name: EPP_IDLE_TIMEOUT
optional.description: Time a session may wait between commands

optional.name: EPP_READ_TIMEOUT
optional.description: Time to read one frame once it has started

optional.name: EPP_WRITE_TIMEOUT
optional.description: Time to write one response

optional.name: EPP_MAX_SESSION_DURATION
optional.description: Longest a session may stay open

optional.name: EPP_DRAIN_TIMEOUT
optional.description: On SIGTERM, time allowed for sessions to finish before their connections are closed

optional.name: EPP_USERNAME
optional.description: EPP client login (clID) used by the epp-client API and the epp CLI. Was hardcoded to a CentralNic OTE account until #411

optional.name: EPP_PASSWORD
optional.description: EPP client password. Was hardcoded alongside EPP_USERNAME until #411; that credential is in git history and should be rotated

optional.name: REDIS_HOST

optional.name: REDIS_PORT
optional.description: Redis port

optional.name: REDIS_PASSWORD
optional.description: Redis password (empty = no auth)

optional.description: Database connections one process may open, at least 2 (a migration holds one for its lock while the schema changes run on another); a quarter of them are kept idle, each is recycled after 30 minutes and closed after 5 idle minutes. The worker needs at least 3: it gives a quarter of it (at least 1, at most 5) to the one pool its escrow importers share and the rest to the pool every other activity shares, never more than the budget in all. Size it so every process together stays under the database's connection limit. The EPP and RDAP nodes use EPP_DB_MAX_OPEN_CONNS and RDAP_DB_MAX_OPEN_CONNS instead

optional.name: SCHEMA_GUARD
optional.description: Startup check that schema_version is at least this build's version: enforce (refuse to start), warn (log and continue) or off. Emergency escape hatch only - leave unset (enforce) in deployed environments

optional.name: AUTH0_ENABLED
optional.description: Enable Auth0 JWT validation

optional.name: AUTH0_DOMAIN
optional.description: Auth0 tenant domain (e.g. dev-xxx.us.auth0.com)

optional.name: AUTH0_AUDIENCE
optional.description: Auth0 API identifier (e.g. https://api.alpaca-test)

optional.name: AUTH0_WORKER_CLIENT_ID
optional.description: Auth0 M2M client ID for worker (preferred over AUTH0_CLIENT_ID)

optional.name: AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
optional.description: Auth0 client ID fallback (if WORKER variant not set)

optional.name: AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET
optional.description: Auth0 client secret fallback (if WORKER variant not set)

optional.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
optional.description: Legacy bearer token (fallback when Auth0 disabled)

optional.name: SNOWFLAKE_NODE_ID
optional.description: The snowflake node this process mints ROIDs on, 0 to 1023; every ROID carries it. One range for every process that writes the same database: two processes on one node can mint the same ROID in the same millisecond, and the second create then fails. Give each service a block and each replica its offset in it: api 0-99, worker 100-199, epp 200-299, cli and importers 900-999, so api-0 is 0, worker-0 is 100, epp-2 is 202. Unset, the node is derived from the host, which is fine for one process and a gamble for a fleet

optional.name: API_URL
optional.description: Full API URL (e.g. https://api.example.com). Preferred over API_HOST+API_PORT.

optional.name: API_HOST
optional.description: API bind host / target host for worker calls

optional.name: API_PORT
optional.description: API bind port / target port for worker calls

optional.name: TEMPORAL_HOST_PORT
optional.description: Temporal server address

optional.name: TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE
optional.description: Temporal namespace

optional.name: TEMPORAL_API_KEY
optional.description: Temporal Cloud API key (replaces mTLS certs)

optional.name: TEMPORAL_CLIENT_KEY
optional.description: Temporal mTLS client key PEM (legacy, use API key instead)

optional.name: TEMPORAL_CLIENT_CERT
optional.description: Temporal mTLS client cert PEM (legacy, use API key instead)

optional.name: STORAGE_AUTH_MODE
optional.description: How to obtain S3 credentials: "static" (access key + secret; MinIO, R2, S3) or "iam" (short-lived credentials from EKS IRSA, ECS task role, or EC2 IMDS; AWS S3 only)

optional.name: STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY
optional.description: S3 access key ID. Required when STORAGE_AUTH_MODE=static; must be unset for iam. Falls back to deprecated MINIO_ACCESS_KEY

optional.name: STORAGE_SECRET_KEY
optional.description: S3 secret access key. Required when STORAGE_AUTH_MODE=static; must be unset for iam. Falls back to deprecated MINIO_SECRET_KEY

optional.name: STORAGE_USE_SSL
optional.description: Use TLS for S3 connections. Falls back to deprecated MINIO_USE_SSL

optional.name: STORAGE_REGION
optional.description: S3 region for SigV4 signing. Set to the bucket's region for AWS S3, "auto" for R2. Empty lets the client resolve it via a bucket-location lookup

optional.name: STORAGE_ESCROW_BUCKET
optional.description: S3 bucket name for RDE/BRDA escrow deposits (contains PII — kept isolated per bucket-storage-strategy)

optional.name: STORAGE_EVENT_LOGS_BUCKET
optional.description: S3 bucket name for gzip JSONL event archive files (warm-tier event search + audit trail)

optional.name: STORAGE_REPORTS_BUCKET
optional.description: S3 bucket name for Spec 5 compliance sweep CSVs and other generated reports. API needs it too for the generic workflow artifact download endpoint

optional.name: STORAGE_TEMP_BUCKET
optional.description: S3 bucket name for workflow-scoped staging artifacts (snapshots, backups, cleanup manifests, verification reports). API needs it too for the generic workflow artifact download endpoint

optional.name: STORAGE_TLS_SKIP_VERIFY
optional.description: Disable TLS certificate verification for S3 connections. Local development against self-signed MinIO only — never enable against R2/S3

optional.name: STORAGE_AUTO_CREATE_BUCKETS
optional.description: Create missing storage buckets on startup. Local development only — production buckets are provisioned out-of-band

optional.name: ESCROW_VALIDATION_DEA_NAME
optional.description: Data Escrow Agent name written into rdeNotification:deaName (1-255 characters)

optional.name: ESCROW_VALIDATION_MAX_COMPRESSED_BYTES
optional.description: Largest .ryde artifact accepted for validation, in bytes (default 10 GiB)

optional.name: ESCROW_VALIDATION_MAX_UNPACKED_BYTES
optional.description: Cumulative plaintext budget across every decompression layer of one deposit, in bytes (default 50 GiB); stops archive bombs

optional.name: ESCROW_VALIDATION_MAX_FILES
optional.description: Maximum tar entries inside a deposit archive

optional.name: ESCROW_VALIDATION_MAX_NESTING
optional.description: Maximum decompression layers (gzip inside gzip, gzip inside tar) inside a deposit

optional.name: ESCROW_VALIDATION_TIMEOUT
optional.description: Wall-clock bound for validating one deposit (Go duration)

optional.name: ESCROW_VALIDATION_MAX_CROSS_REFERENCE_OBJECTS
optional.description: How many identifiers the contact/host referential check may hold for one deposit. It is the only check that cannot work in constant space, and each entry costs about 30 bytes, so the default is roughly 580 MB held and 670 MB at the peak — size it to the worker's memory limit. Past it the deposit is still validated and the check reports RDE_CROSS_REFERENCE_SKIPPED

optional.name: ESCROW_VALIDATION_MAX_CROSS_REFERENCE_NAMES
optional.description: How many of those identifiers are also kept verbatim so a finding can name the object rather than only its ordinal. About 60 bytes each, so it is deliberately smaller than the bound above; past it findings carry an ordinal and a byte offset instead of a name

optional.name: ESCROW_INTAKE_SFTP_ENABLED
optional.description: Validate escrow deposits that arrive over sFTP: the escrow-intake-sweep schedule always runs, and finds nothing to do while this is false

optional.name: ESCROW_INTAKE_SFTP_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT
optional.description: Also accept a lone unsigned <name>.xml or <name>.xml.gz uploaded over sFTP as a deposit, validated with the plaintext profile. Unsigned deposits are registry data in the clear at rest, so keep this off outside test and simulation environments; while off they are left in the inbox and counted in the sweep result

optional.name: ESCROW_INTAKE_SFTP_PREFIX
optional.description: Escrow bucket prefix the sFTP server writes under; deposits are read from <prefix>inbox/<RyID>/<tld>/ and moved to <prefix>claimed/ and <prefix>rejected/. Must not overlap escrow-validation/ or uploads/

optional.name: ESCROW_INTAKE_SWEEP_INTERVAL
optional.description: How often the sFTP intake sweep looks for new deposits (Go duration, at least 30s). Applied to the schedule when the worker starts

optional.name: ESCROW_CUSTODY_BACKEND
optional.description: Escrow key store: none or aws-secrets-manager. With none, public keys and unsigned deposits still work, and importing or probing a private key reports KEY_STORE_NOT_CONFIGURED

optional.name: ESCROW_CUSTODY_AWS_REGION
optional.description: AWS region of the Secrets Manager holding escrow key material

optional.name: ESCROW_CUSTODY_NAME_PREFIX
optional.description: Prefix of every escrow key secret name (<prefix>/escrow-keys/...). IAM policies are written against it; a stored reference keeps its full name, so changing the prefix does not orphan existing keys

optional.name: ESCROW_CUSTODY_ENDPOINT
optional.description: Secrets Manager endpoint override for development (LocalStack, e.g. http://localstack:4566). Leave empty in AWS

optional.name: ESCROW_SANITIZE_SUFFIX
optional.description: Synthetic registry suffix every in-bailiwick FQDN in a derivative is rewritten to, e.g. domain.suffix becomes domain.artful-dodger. Overridable per launch; must differ from the source TLD

optional.name: ESCROW_SANITIZE_MAX_XML_DEPTH
optional.description: Maximum XML nesting depth accepted from a deposit being sanitized

optional.name: ESCROW_SANITIZE_MAX_ELEMENTS
optional.description: Maximum number of XML elements accepted from a deposit being sanitized. Generous by design: a large TLD legitimately produces hundreds of millions

optional.name: ESCROW_SANITIZE_MAX_FIELD_BYTES
optional.description: Maximum length of a single XML field value accepted from a deposit being sanitized

optional.name: ESCROW_SANITIZE_TIMEOUT
optional.description: Wall-clock budget for producing and verifying one derivative

required.name: ROID_REPOSITORY_ID
required.description: The registry's EPP repository ID, registered with IANA (https://www.iana.org/assignments/epp-repository-ids): 1 to 8 letters or digits. Every ROID ends in it (e.g. 123_DOM-XYZ): only the number is stored, and the ID is appended when a ROID is read. Set it once, before the first start: the database records it then, and a process configured with a different one refuses to start. Any value will do for local development
